name: Album of Miscellaneous Subjects, Colophon
material: album leaf, ink and color on silk
summary: The Japanese artist Tomioka Tessai (1836-1924) adds a colophon on the last page, commenting on the rarity of Fan Qi's paintings among those of the Eight Masters of Nanjing.
